5 Sep 2023
Claim reported by the claimant after a collision at an intersection while turning left, with the other vehicle striking the
claimant's car on the driver side. Claimant reports neck pain and has not yet been seen by a medical provider.
22 Sep 2023
Spoke with the claimant, who is not represented by an attorney, and confirmed the basic account of the accident. The
claimant described the same sequence of events as in the first report.
9 Nov 2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scnee and records the other driver's
statement. Witness statements and scene photos match the description given by the claimant.
22 Nov 2023
Reviewed the photos of the vehicle, and the damage pattern is consistent with the impact described. The impact
appeared fairly light, which makes the reported neck injury look more significant than I would expect from a collision
of this kind.
18 Dec 2023
Checked prior claims and medical history. No earlier injury to the neck or upper back is on record, and no prior
damage to the vehicle has been found. Nothing indicates the damage predates the start of coverage.
21 Feb 2024
Confirmed that the driver is a household member of the policyholder and qualifies for coverage under the policy.
Treatment has continued for a somewhat longer period than is typical for a strain of this type.
28 Mar 2024
Claimant has given the same account in each convesration so far. Based on the evidence reviewed, the claim
remains open pending the medical records and the final treatment summary.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
